review.notes: Full review of README.md (1479 lines) and Suggested.lean (417 lines). Gate rerun at this head: every counter 0, OK; depcheck: 234 roadmaps, 2270 edges, 0 problem(s); lake env lean exit 0 with 15 sorry warnings only. All 26 declarations checked with #check, no lost binders; one-tactic probe fails on all 15 headlines. Four witnesses elaborated in scratch (Haar-conjugated asymptotic freeness, GOE F1 with Hastings-McLeod q as hypothesis, speed-n^2 GOE/GUE empirical-measure LDP, AGZ 5.4.2 at its own generality). Previous review R01-R10 all repaired. Seeded sample checked against AGZ, Bai 1999, Tao, TVK 2010, RV 2008, Tropp 2012: 0.1, 1.2 (wrong AGZ lemma), 4.3, 4.5, 5.1 (no locator), 5.2, 6.2, 6.4, 7.2 (no locator, hypotheses beyond Bai Thm 3.4/Remark 3.2), 8.5, 8.6, 9.4 (content differs from AGZ L2.6.2(e)), 9.5, 10.3; BLM, Vershynin HDP and Johansson 1998 not verifiable. Blocking: Haar freeness statable but absent (P2); F1 and n^2 LDP wrongly called unstatable (P2); wigner_asymptotically_free narrower than README/AGZ 5.4.2 (P2); CompactGroups weyl_integration_formula is SU(2) only, so the U(n) Weyl formula of 5.4 has no supplier (P2). 31-row adversarial table with computed values; two AGZ misprints recorded.
